dimensions.name: cdc_safety
dimensions.description: CDC refusal, safe pattern selection, and coherency warnings.

dimensions.name: project_adaptation

dimensions.name: bug_prevention
dimensions.description: Proactive bug pattern matching, known-pattern warnings, and prevention assertions during RTL generation.

dimensions.name: tool_driven_verification
dimensions.description: Tool-driven RTL verification: compile, simulate, interpret output, iterate fixes.

dimensions.name: low_power_design
dimensions.description: Clock gating, operand isolation, power domains, UPF basics, and power-aware verification.

dimensions.name: dft_awareness
dimensions.description: Scan chain readiness, memory BIST, test-mode overrides, and DFT-friendly RTL patterns.

dimensions.name: uvm_methodology
dimensions.description: Constrained-random verification, coverage-driven closure, UVM architecture, and scoreboard strategy.

dimensions.name: synthesis_timing_closure
dimensions.description: Synthesis-aware RTL, SDC constraints, critical path optimization, and area/timing tradeoffs.

dimensions.name: formal_verification
dimensions.description: SVA properties for formal, safety/liveness classification, and formal vs simulation guidance.

dimensions.name: physical_awareness
dimensions.description: Floorplanning, wire delay, IO planning, clock tree synthesis, and package considerations for RTL engineers.

dimensions.name: verification_planning
dimensions.description: Verification plans with coverage models, constrained-random strategy, directed tests, and exit criteria.

dimensions.name: uvm_testbench
dimensions.description: UVM-structured testbench with transaction, driver, monitor, scoreboard, and coverage collector.

dimensions.name: design_intuition
dimensions.description: FIFO depth sizing, pipeline stage count, area/timing estimation, and red flag identification using engineering heuristics.

dimensions.name: nvme_dma_false_pass
dimensions.description: Detection of false-pass NVMe/DMA testbenches: log audit for undetected data mismatches, NVM source offset page-reset, PRP list buffer-parameter mismatch, unused protocol response inputs.

dimensions.name: fsm_datapath_purity
dimensions.description: FSM-datapath structural purity: RSP1-RSP7 gate enforcement, control-signal gating, no cstate in datapath, no multi-bit in FSM comb.

dimensions.name: nvme_prp_completeness
dimensions.description: NVMe PRP completeness: non-zero offset, page/list boundary, alignment, chain pointer, opcode/nsid validation, transaction-shape scoreboard.

dimensions.name: delegation_decision_gate
dimensions.description: Explicit delegation decision after L0/L1/L2 classification: yes/no record, role assignment or waiver, contract-freeze precondition.

dimensions.name: workflow_routing_release_gate
dimensions.description: Task mode routing (design/review/debug/protocol-audit) + L2 sub-agent Release Gate with contract-freeze + acceptance commands + RSP1-RSP7 prompt requirements.

dimensions.name: workflow_routing_gate_first_review
dimensions.description: Review-mode routing must skip full RTL generation and run evidence/gate checks before manual hotspot review.

dimensions.name: project_skeleton_preflight_no_spec
dimensions.description: No-SPEC L1/L2 projects must create docs/, rtl/, tb/, sim/ and canonical skeleton documents before RTL.

dimensions.name: guarded_sim_wrapper_timeout_vcd_limit
dimensions.description: Simulation must use run_sim_guarded.py with timeout and artifact-size failure behavior instead of bare vvp.

dimensions.name: protocol_claim_ledger
dimensions.description: Structured protocol claim tracking: claim/label/source/section/applied-in/evidence for every must/shall/violation.

dimensions.name: spec_tb_reliability
dimensions.description: SPEC consistency verification (formulas/units/protocol claims self-consistent) + TB reliability gates (unbounded wait protection, cap_cnt vs expected, status/response propagation).

dimensions.name: contract_implementation_closure
dimensions.description: Contract-implementation matrix: RTL producer/consumer, TB check, waiver for every contract item. Residual risk tier classification (Blocking/Accepted/Residual).

dimensions.name: final_delivery_fail_closed
dimensions.description: Final delivery gate aggregation: project artifacts, RTL style, compile logs, and simulation logs must all pass before any PASS claim.

dimensions.name: per_module_sim_gate
dimensions.description: L2 projects must run per-module simulation/proof before integration and record module_verification_matrix evidence.

dimensions.name: gate_false_positive_resilience
dimensions.description: Automation gates must avoid known false positives while still rejecting real failures.

dimensions.name: pre_integration_lock
dimensions.description: L2 projects must not run integration simulation until per-module evidence exists. pre_integration_gate.py rejects integration TB/sim artifacts before module evidence.

dimensions.name: delegation_provenance
dimensions.description: Delegate: yes requires provenance fields (Role, Scope, Input contract, Evidence source, Acceptance commands, Findings) in each subagent role report.

dimensions.name: l2_classification_hardening
dimensions.description: Artifact-based L2 inference (RTL count, multi-protocol signals) overrides silent dev_log. Both preflight and artifact gates apply consistently.

dimensions.name: rsp2_level_escalation
dimensions.description: RSP2 multi-bit datapath in FSM combinational block is E-level for L2 projects (--level L2 flag).

dimensions.name: empty_compile_log
dimensions.description: Empty or whitespace-only compile logs must fail compile_log_gate.py.

dimensions.name: expected_timeout_allowance
dimensions.description: Expected timeout-protection test text (TEST_PASS.*timeout, status=TIMEOUT) allowed when ALL_TESTS_PASS and SIMULATION_DONE exist. Real RUN_SIM_GUARDED: TIMEOUT still rejected.

dimensions.name: standard_log_artifact
dimensions.description: Standard .log files from run_sim_guarded.py required for delivery. .vvp without .log is insufficient evidence.

dimensions.name: scoreboard_substance
dimensions.description: DMA/NVMe TBs must compare AWADDR/AWLEN/WLAST/WSTRB/BRESP against expected values. Signal-name mention alone is not scoreboard evidence.

dimensions.name: prp_feature_claim
dimensions.description: PRP list support claims require actual fetch/load path in RTL. list_mem without load interface or PRP1 offset without RTL logic must be Blocking Gap.
